summary: The build has the wrong top 10: Nevada (really #7) is missing and charges a life, and Idaho (really #14) is in its place. Fixed, it is a solid, easy-ish daily.
reasons: The Wikipedia table has bad km2 cells: Nevada 382.936, Idaho 275,213, Florida 183.924. The mi2 column is right.
So Nevada ranks #54 and costs a life, the most natural guess on the list after the big four.
Idaho sits at #7 instead of #14, so the board teaches a wrong fact.
Correct top 10: Alaska, Texas, California, Montana, New Mexico, Arizona, Nevada, Colorado, Oregon, Wyoming.
Once fixed: everyone knows the names, near misses are fair and fun (Michigan #11 via the Great Lakes, Utah #13).
A bit gimme-heavy for Americans: listing the big western states nearly clears it.
Not Blitz-ready yet (no stats); with stats from the rebuild, 50 states would make a deep Blitz.
fixes: us-states-area: take values from the mi2 column ("Total area / mi", unit mi2) or convert mi2 x 2.58999 to km2; the km2 cells for Nevada (382.936), Idaho (275,213) and Florida (183.924) are wrong on the source page. Expected after fix: #7 Nevada 286,380 km2, Idaho #14 216,443, Florida #22 170,312.
Pipeline guard: flag a value parsed with a dot as thousands separator (382.936) or a km2/mi2 ratio far from 2.59 in the same row, instead of ranking it silently.
Postal codes are inconsistent: AZ, TX, AK, WY match but NM, NV, CO, OR, MT do not. Add all 50 USPS codes for the us-states universe (free misses, but uneven).

Drop junk aliases: "City" (Georgia, and it also offers Alaska), "Arizona Governor's Mansion", "Arizona Department of Commerce", "Wyoming factsheet", "Wyoming metropolitan areas", "Montana state slogan", "Recording District", "Michigan economy", and the "Transportation in / Crime in / Law of X" redirects.
